Live product
Booking app for diagnostic labs · Built in-house

LabBook: online test booking for labs

Patients pick a test and a time slot from their phone in about 30 seconds. The booking lands on the lab's dashboard straight away, and the patient gets a WhatsApp confirmation. No app, no login.

The lab sets how many bookings each slot can take. When a slot is full it stops being offered, so two people can never take the same place.

About the founder

Meet the person building your product.

No account managers. No handoffs. The developer and the founder are the same person.

Naveen Kasula
Founder & MERN Developer

I am Kasula Naveen Kumar, founder of UnityWebWorks and a MERN stack developer based in Hyderabad, originally from Laxmapur village in Medak district. UnityWebWorks is a solo studio, which means every website, app and automation goes through my hands directly.

I graduated with my Master of Computer Applications from St.Vincent PG College in May 2025, after a Bachelor's in Marketing Management from Nizam College, Hyderabad in 2022. Earlier in 2024–25, I spent six months as a Claims Representative at Optum Global Solution (UnitedHealth Group) in Hyderabad, handling insurance claims with 100% accuracy. I bring the same precision to code and ad campaigns.

My work combines two sides: engineering (React, Next.js, Node, MongoDB, React Native, n8n) and growth (Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, lead generation). That full-stack range is what lets me build real growth systems for small businesses instead of just a static page.

Questions

Answers before you ask.

Are you a solo developer or a team?

Solo. I am Kasula Naveen Kumar, founder of UnityWebWorks and a MERN developer based in Hyderabad. For design-heavy or video-heavy projects I bring in a trusted editor friend. You always deal with me directly.

Do you work with businesses outside India?

Yes. I take Upwork, Fiverr and direct international clients. Prices quoted in USD on request. Communication over WhatsApp, email or Google Meet.

What tech stack do you build on?

Default: Next.js + React + MongoDB + Node.js, hosted on Vercel. Simpler sites: WordPress or static HTML. Mobile: React Native. Automation: n8n and Zapier. Happy to work in whatever stack you already have.

How do payments work?

50% advance to start, 50% on delivery. UPI, bank transfer, or international wire. GST invoice provided. Monthly retainers billed on the 1st.

What if I need changes after launch?

First 30 days of fixes are free. After that, small changes are hourly; larger changes are quoted. Many clients continue on a monthly retainer for ongoing updates, ads and SEO.

Do I own the code after you deliver?

Yes. Full source code goes to your GitHub, your Vercel account, your domain, your hosting. You own everything. I never hold code hostage.
